name: Footer
summary: The bar at the bottom of the product: link groups, the legal line, locale or status.

groups.description: Columns of links, each under a heading

legal.description: The line at the very bottom: copyright, licence, company details

aside.description: Something at the end of the legal row: a locale Choice, a status Tag, a Text

whenToUse: The footer region of a Frame
Public services and marketing-adjacent products where legal and help links belong at the bottom
whenNotToUse: Dense tools where nothing lives below the fold: leave the Frame's footer out

requirements: Groups are navigation regions named by their headings
Links are links, not buttons, when they leave the current screen
The legal line is readable text, not an image

agent: Reads the legal line and reaches help, privacy and terms by name.
rendering: Groups as columns on wide layouts, stacked on compact; headings in type.label.default
Background color.surface.subtle with a top border; the legal row in type.body.small, color.text.muted

mappings.web: GOV.UK footer, Polaris FooterHelp, Bootstrap footer
